# generate_synthetic_experiment.R

## generate_synthetic_experiment()

```{r}
generate_synthetic_experiment(output_dir = "synthetic",
                             verbose = TRUE)
```


# extract_identity_barcode_info.R

## extract_identity_barcode_info()

```{r}
extract_identity_barcode_info(source_dir = "data/testing",
                              sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
                              identity_AmpID = "AMPL902654",
                              output_dir = "data/testing",
                              plots_output_dir = "plots",
                              verbose = TRUE)
```


# evaluate_optimal_barcode_flanks.R

## evaluate_optimal_barcode_flanks()

```{r}
evaluate_optimal_barcode_flanks(source_dir = "data/testing",
                                sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
```

# identify_whitelisted_barcodes.R

## identify_whitelisted_barcodes()

```{r}
identify_whitelisted_barcodes(source_dir = "data/testing",
                              sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
                              whitelist_barcode_files = list(
                                BC1 = "BC1_whitelist_barcodes.csv",
                                BC2 = "BC2_whitelist_barcodes.csv",
                                BC3 = "BC3_whitelist_barcodes.csv"
                              ),
                              n_threads = 4,
                              output_dir = "data/testing",
                              plots_output_dir = "plots",
                              verbose = TRUE)
```


# assign_identity_barcodes.R

## assign_identity_barcodes()

```{r}
assign_identity_barcodes(source_dir = "data/testing",
                         sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
                         BC_thresholds = list(BC1 = 3, 
                                              BC2 = 5, 
                                              BC3 = 5),
                         reads_thresholds = list(min_reads = 5,
                                                 min_reads_proportion = 0.9),
                         output_dir = "data/testing",
                         verbose = TRUE)
```

# identify_true_mutations.R

```{r}
                        sample_name = "MB_barcoded",

                        true_mutation_proportion = 0.1,
                        barcoded = TRUE,
                        min_cells = 3,
                        output_dir = "data/testing",
                        verbose = TRUE)
```

# genotype_cells.R

## genotype_cells()

```{r}

               sample_name = "MB_barcoded",
               panel_ID = "6915",
               alpha_0 = "empirical",

               verbose = TRUE)
```
